Wholesale Plastic Beer Glasses, Mugs and Steins

Steins, tulip pints, hiball tumblers and heavy-base mugs for high-throughput beer service.

Request beer glasses & mugs pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Beer service at volume punishes drinkware: mugs get stacked wet, knocked off trays and dumped into bus tubs. This range uses heavier base walls and reinforced handles so the glass feels substantial in the hand and survives commercial handling. Tulip pints and pilsner shapes present a proper head, while the plain hiball tumbler is the most economical route to a matched house glass across every drink on your menu.

Beer Glasses &amp; Mugs — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Beer Glasses & Mugs range include?

This range holds 7 items, specified in PS and PP. Orders come most often from bars and brewpubs, stadiums and festivals and hotels and resorts. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

What beer glasses & mugs can I source in bulk?

This range covers the shapes, capacities and materials listed on the product cards, with gift-set configurations available. Each product page states its exact available specification and customization route.

Beer glasses and mugs

Can beer glasses & mugs be branded for a distillery, brewery or bar?

Branding feasibility is confirmed from the selected item, artwork, decoration area, quantity and required packaging. Provide the logo and the intended application for a product-specific recommendation.

Bars and nightclubs · Logo decoration guide

How is a gift set configured?

The set is specified as a complete build: the items, any accessories, the insert, the gift box, branding, the outer carton and the quantity. We do not use generic set specifications when the actual configured contents differ.

Barware gift sets

What is the difference between a standard order and a branded gift-set order?

A standard order is quoted against the selected product specification. A branded gift set requires additional confirmation for decoration, packing materials, insert configuration and the complete order quantity.
